---
title: "Higher corporate taxes make paying for Biden’s spending harder"
date: "2021-05-04"
categories: ["Fiscal Policy"]
---

I have an op-ed in the [AFR](https://www.afr.com/politics/higher-corporate-taxes-make-paying-for-biden-s-spending-harder-20210503-p57ok3) noting that the Biden Administration’s proposed higher corporate tax rate will penalise US companies relative to foreign competitors and reduce investment and incentives to produce in the US relative to the rest of the world.
